family.description: This entry represents a set of three HEAT repeats found towards the N-terminal region of Gcn1 protein, which acts as a translation activator that mediates translational control by regulating Gcn2 kinase activity [[cite:PUB00042775]]. It is a ribosome collision sensor that activates a translation quality control pathway when a ribosome has stalled during translation [[cite:PUB00159899]].
family.name: Generalcontrol nonderepressible 1 (Gcn1) N-terminal
